# BFInfinite changelog

## r6-alpha — 2026-08-14 00:00 GMT+8

### English (enUS)

- Rebuilt Unit Frame Buffs and Debuffs for WoW 12.1 with native Aura Containers, and migrated the upper-right display and enemy Nameplate debuffs to native aura rows
- Added configurable Party and Raid dispel highlights, supported aura filters, and global spell colors for Unit Frames
- Added profile-aware Click Casting for BFI Unit Frames, supporting spells, macros, items, and target actions
- Added Objective Tracker position and height controls, with an option to stack BFI Damage Meters beneath it
- Added optional quest acceptance and turn-in automation; hold Shift to keep a quest interaction manual
- Updated Cooldown Manager lifecycle handling and tracked-bar presentation for WoW 12.1

### 简体中文 (zhCN)

- 使用《魔兽世界》12.1 原生光环容器重构了单位框体的增益与减益，并将右上角显示和敌方姓名板减益迁移到原生光环行
- 为单位框体新增可配置的小队和团队驱散高亮、受支持的光环筛选条件及全局法术颜色
- 为 BFI 单位框体新增按配置文件保存的点击施法，支持法术、宏、物品和目标动作
- 新增目标追踪器位置和高度设置，并可将 BFI 伤害统计堆叠在其下方
- 新增可选的自动接取和交还任务功能；按住 Shift 可保持任务交互为手动
- 更新冷却管理器的生命周期处理和追踪条外观，以适配《魔兽世界》12.1

## r5-alpha — 2026-08-04 00:00 GMT+8

### English (enUS)

- Individual Bags view keeps full-size icons and grows from the Combined View baseline height
- Sidebar category expansion now persists when the sidebar collapses
- Sidebar category icons across every category (equipment, consumables, trade goods, recipes, reagents, quest items, and housing) now render as larger, full-color native in-game art on plated backgrounds
- Sidebar toggle now collapses and expands the sidebar instantly, replacing the old auto-hide behavior
- The collapsed sidebar rail now shows expand/collapse chevrons next to each category icon
- The sidebar rail now sits flush with the bag window's edge

### 简体中文 (zhCN)

- 独立背包视图保留完整大小的图标，并以合并视图的基准高度为起点向上增长
- 侧栏收起时，侧栏分类的展开状态现在会保留
- 侧栏所有分类（装备、消耗品、贸易物品、配方、材料、任务物品和房屋）的图标现在都以更大尺寸的全彩游戏内原生素材呈现，并带有底板背景
- 侧栏切换按钮现在可以立即收起或展开侧栏，取代了原有的自动隐藏方式
- 收起状态下的侧栏现在会在每个分类图标旁显示展开/收起箭头
- 侧栏现在与背包窗口边缘对齐
